services:
  scraping-web:
    image: python:3.12-slim
    container_name: scraping-belgique
    restart: unless-stopped
    working_dir: /app
    ports:
      - "5000:5000"
    volumes:
      - scraping-output:/app/output
    environment:
      - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
    command:
      - bash
      - -c
      - |
        mkdir -p /app/output /app/scrapers /app/web/templates /app/web/static
        echo  | base64 -d | tar xzf - -C /app
        pip install --no-cache-dir -r /app/requirements.txt -q
        exec gunicorn wsgi:app --bind 0.0.0.0:5000 --workers 2 --threads 4 --timeout 600 --access-logfile - --error-logfile -

volumes:
  scraping-output:
